reflected_callback_no_disposition.description: Reflected File Download (RFD) -- a reflective JSON/API/JSONP endpoint echoes attacker-controlled input into a downloadable response with NO Content-Disposition filename forcing, so a URL like /api/data;/setup.bat?cb=||calc|| makes the browser save an attacker-named .bat/.cmd whose body is attacker-controlled commands. Chains to command execution on the victim host. Detection: input reflected in the body AND the response does not force a safe filename/inline disposition.

probes.description: Reflected callback value -- if ||calc.exe|| is echoed into a downloadable body with no Content-Disposition, an attacker sets the URL to force a .bat download that runs on open.
Leading-command marker -- a body starting with the reflected value (JSONP callback / echoed field) lets `setup.bat` execute `rfdmarker` first. Confirm the value lands at/near the body start.
